Percy’s mother, and a vampire. She is a teacher at the spy academy, and her codename is “Acro Bat,” a play on her vampire race. Her boobs are a firm and well-shaped P-cup, something she is apparently very proud of.

She is an extremely rare type of vampire: a hot-blooded athletic vampire who is energetic even during the daytime. Apparently she overcame sunlight through “hard work and guts,” and people meeting her for the first time almost never guess her true race. She married a human man, and together they had their dhampir daughter, Percy.

Her subjects are physical education and dark magic, though according to herself, she is apparently terrible at dark magic. Her physical abilities are extraordinarily high, and during her student days, despite belonging to Snake Unit, she was said to rival even the students of Wolfard. She oversees multiple athletic clubs as an advisor, and spends every day constantly busy. Also, because “they’re easy to move around in and comfortable,” she always wears her gym uniform.

Her personality is cheerful, lively, and straightforward, and because she is easygoing and fun to be around, she is quite popular among the students. She basically believes that anything can be solved through hard work and guts, and is the type whose body moves before her brain does. To the students, she feels less like a teacher and more like a dependable older sister.

She teases her daughter Percy for being weak during the daytime, though the relationship between parent and child is very good. She keeps trying to put Percy through intense “guts training” to overcome sunlight, something her daughter absolutely hates. However, since Percy’s physical abilities increase at night, the two of them often leap around the city together after dark.

She immediately took a liking to the protagonist because of his strong physique, and the two quickly became close. She often tries to enjoy outdoor activities together with him, though apparently Percy keeps getting in the way. Because of that, rumors say she has even been sneaking into the protagonist’s room at night in hopes of sharing his bed.

Her hobbies are physical activity and watching sports. The things she dislikes are restrictive clothing, and movies that need to be watched more than twice to understand.
